newsitem.title: USA: SEACOR Holdings to buy Galaxie Marine.
newsitem.headline: SEACOR Holdings to buy Galaxie Marine.

text.p: SEACOR Holdings Inc said on Tuesday that it had signed a letter of intent to acquire substantially all of the assets, excluding real estate, of Galaxie Marine Service Inc and affiliated companies for about $21.0 million.
The deal is subject to adjustment for inventory and other assets, SEACOR Holdings said.

SEACOR said the purchase consideration will consist of $18.2 million in cash, to be provided through a combination of borrowings and existing cash balances, and 50,000 shares of SEACOR common stock. The shares, based upon SEACOR closing price on Oct. 28, have a value of $2.8 million.
SEACOR said it expects the deal to close in January.
Galaxie Marine of Patterson, La., owns a fleet of 24 offshore vessels dedicated to serving the oil and gas industry in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico.
